title: Paladin Guide
subtitle: Amarr Marauder
body:
# Paladin

---

The Paladin is an Amarr marauder and is a primary DPS ship in armor fleets. 

## Key Points

- Activate Bastion when in position. Iit locks you in place for 60 seconds but dramatically boosts your  damage.
- Don't bastion with aggro unless an FC tells you to.
- Use Conflagration for close range (<43), Scorch for longer range(>43). Switch ammo types based on what you're shooting.
- Use your armor rep when battle reps are called for.
- Use your cap transmitter when battle caps are called for or when a ship asks for it.

## Bastion Timing

Enter Bastion once the FC calls the wave and you are in position. Do not enter Bastion while burning to your anchor. Come out of Bastion before the wave ends so you can move to your next anchor position.

## Anchoring

Follow FC anchor calls. The Paladin's MJD lets you jump 100km instantly — use it to reposition efficiently between waves.
